I am a woman alone with this small piece of land, less than half a hectare, and maize is what feeds my family. If the coupon comes from the government I will use the fertilizer, because one bag of NPK and one bag of urea is what everyone in my village uses when they get the chance — without the coupon I cannot afford even one bag at the agro-dealer's price. I always put the goat droppings and the ash from my kitchen on the maize, because that costs me nothing and my mother taught me this. I plant the seeds I kept from last year's harvest because the hybrid seed is too dear for me, and I weed myself with my hoe — I have no money to pay anyone.
